summary: Important security alerts now also reach Invardia support, so help can start before you ask.

fixes.title: Security alerts also reach Invardia support
fixes.text: Live access that differs from your definitions, new unmanaged privileged roles or groups, and break-glass being switched on now also alert Invardia support.

fixes.title: Support can tell long jobs from stuck ones
fixes.text: Update stages and running PIM jobs with their duration are now reported to Invardia support.

fixes.title: Right-sized new installations
fixes.text: A new installation starts at 2 CPU and 4 GiB, or 4 CPU and 8 GiB from 15,000 users, instead of being raised later.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: A resumed install never reuses another version's package, and settings pages store only the values you set yourself.
